azure.review.synapse.selected_notebook_s.description: Inspect source cells returned for one explicitly selected published Synapse notebook, with ARM workspace and native notebook identity bound before and after the read. The result covers only the captured source cells and does not describe execution, outputs, referenced files, connected Git content, or all notebooks.
evaluated: ARM subscription tenant and workspace id, name, type, dev endpoint and identity tenant
native notebook id, name, type, ETag and properties.cells[].source before and after
Kingfisher and TruffleHog offline engine statuses and private HMAC leak identities
azure.review.synapse.selected_notebook_s.pass_when: The exact selected source is bound and unchanged across native reads, and both offline detectors finish without a supported secret finding.
azure.review.synapse.selected_notebook_s.fail_when: A bound selected source cell contains a likely secret found by a completed offline detector, even if the other detector is unavailable.
azure.review.synapse.selected_notebook_s.unknown_when: The source, ownership, ETag, wire response, or clean detector coverage is missing or changed.
